# Woodstock HVAC Pros

> Woodstock HVAC Pros provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Woodstock, Oxford County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 539-4170  |  Email: contact@woodstockhvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://woodstockhvacpros.ca

Service areas: Woodstock, Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Thamesford, Embro
